Its dedicated 'Regulace' rubric carries practitioner and compliance-officer commentary on upcoming CRR/CRD, DORA, PSD3, AML rules and ČNB supervisory expectations — the closest thing to an industry-insider read on Czech banking regulation.

brief: Czech-language media coverage of financial regulation splits into three usable layers: mass/business desks (HN, E15, Seznam Zprávy, iROZHLAS) that reveal political conflict, delays and enforcement pressure; specialist consumer/SME portals (Měšec.cz, Peníze.cz, Podnikatel.cz) that translate rules into effective dates and concrete obligations; and practitioner channels (Bankovnictví's Regulace rubric, epravo.cz, FINREG PARTNERS, FinTech Cowboys) that carry the compliance detail and the industry's criticism of drafts. The most valuable layer is also the most gated — HN and the Bankovnictví print edition are subscription-only — so a Czech media-monitoring licence is the main unlock for this cell. ČNB's own newsroom and enforcement register should be tracked alongside as the terse official baseline, since the analytical value here is precisely the delta between what the regulator published and what journalists reported. All URLs in this slice come from observed search results or inferred site conventions and are explicitly unverified for liveness.
